messages:
Maya (Sales): 1735123456
Hey team — kicking off Iris Therapeutics auth/provisioning POC. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM for users + groups, RBAC, and strict domain controls. Can we align on what's needed for a week-long POC and get a pricing baseline?

Jia (SE): 1735123612
Short checklist:
- SAML IdP/SP metadata
- SCIM endpoint with delta support (or we fall back to full sync)
- Group mapping for RBAC
- Domain ownership proof (TXT or email)
I can share a sample SAML metadata and a SCIM schema.

Sam (Security): 1735123856
What's their compliance requirement? HIPAA? We'll need to confirm encryption in transit + KMS for Private. Also prefer SHA256 signing for SAML. No SHA1.

Jia (SE): 1735124120
Sample SAML metadata snippet for SP (paste):
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example.com/sp/iris">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true" WantAssertionsSigned="true">
    <NameIDFormat>urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress</NameIDFormat>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://iris.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs" />
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
For SCIM: we support PATCH with bulk upserts; can support 5000 users/min in Dedicated. For Hosted, recommend starting with delta + rate limits.

Maya (Sales): 1735124320
Customer asks about pricing: one-week POC (light load), then scale to 5k users. What's a ballpark for a hosted test vs a Dedicated 1-month trial? Also they want 'no data retention' for POC.

Alex (Product): 1735124500
RBAC: we map SCIM groups -> roles in Redwood Console. Can create tenant-scoped roles and enforce domain-locked orgs. For 'no data retention' we can set short retention and purge on teardown; need legal sign-off for irreversible deletes.

Sam (Security): 1735124600
We need customer to sign DPA and an SSA if HIPAA. Also capture requirement for domain control proof — recommend DNS TXT for speed. For SAML, insist on SHA256 signatures and assertion encryption if PHI.

Jia (SE): 1735124725
POC plan:
1) Day 0: exchange metadata + SCIM creds
2) Day 1: SAML test (SP-initiated)
3) Day 2: SCIM sync + group mapping
4) Day 3-5: Load/edge cases, RBAC validation
Will need 1 SE + 1 Solutions Eng touch. I'll provision a test tenant and sample users.

deploy-bot: 1735124800
Ticket #INC-9876 created: iris-poc-auth-provisioning. Meeting scheduled: 2024-05-14 16:00 UTC (calendar invite sent).

Maya (Sales): 1735124920
Thanks — next actions: Jia to send metadata + SCIM endpoint details; Sam to confirm DPA/HIPAA checklist; I'll send a hosted vs dedicated cost ballpark by EOD.
:thumbsup:
